SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is the highest mountain in Kenya? (1 mark)
   A. Mount Kenya
   B. Mount Elgon
   C. Ngong Hills
   D. Aberdare Range

2. Which of these is most likely to happen in the rainy season? (1 mark)
   A. Grass dries up completely
   B. Herders move very far for water
   C. Rivers fill with water
   D. Farmers harvest all their maize

3. Which of these is a human resource? (1 mark)
   A. A lake
   B. A forest
   C. A mineral
   D. A skilled farmer

4. In an essay on good citizenship, what should the beginning say? (1 mark)
   A. What a good citizen is
   B. The weather report
   C. A recipe
   D. A list of foods

5. How often are general elections held in Kenya? (1 mark)
   A. Every ten years
   B. Every year
   C. Every month
   D. Every five years

6. How many counties does Kenya have? (1 mark)
   A. 47
   B. 27
   C. 37
   D. 57

7. Which type of area in Kenya usually has few people for its size? (1 mark)
   A. Dry areas in the far north
   B. Busy lakeshores
   C. Highlands around Mount Kenya
   D. Big cities

8. Which action shows responsibility? (1 mark)
   A. Doing your class duty without being reminded
   B. Breaking things
   C. Refusing to help
   D. Waiting to be told each time

9. What is a candidate? (1 mark)
   A. A person who stands to be elected
   B. A cleaner
   C. A teacher
   D. A voter

10. What is a Children's Government in school? (1 mark)
   A. A group of teachers
   B. The government of Kenya
   C. A group of parents
   D. A group of elected pupils who help to run the school

11. Which of these should a good county sketch map have? (1 mark)
   A. A title
   B. A photograph of the teacher
   C. A picture of a tractor
   D. A recipe

12. What is the name of the organisation that looks after most museums in Kenya? (1 mark)
   A. Kenya Airways
   B. Kenya Ports
   C. National Museums of Kenya
   D. Kenya Power

13. Which law forbids child labour and FGM in Kenya? (1 mark)
   A. Nothing forbids it
   B. Only school rules
   C. Only a poster
   D. The law of Kenya, including the Constitution and the Children Act

14. On a timeline, which event comes first? (1 mark)
   A. The biggest event
   B. The oldest event
   C. The funniest event
   D. The newest event

15. Why do tourists visit historic places? (1 mark)
   A. To plant maize
   B. To learn about the past and enjoy the sights
   C. To cut trees
   D. To buy soap

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. What does the Kiswahili word amani mean and why is it important in a school? (2 marks)

17. Draw a side view of the land showing a mountain, a valley and a plain and label them. (5 marks)

18. Explain the meaning of a good citizen in school. (2 marks)

19. Where can a child go for help if they are being harmed? (2 marks)

20. On a sketch map the school is in the middle, the market is above it and the clinic is below it. Write two sentences to say where the market and the clinic are. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Mount Kenya
   Mount Kenya is the highest mountain in Kenya.

2. C — Rivers fill with water
   Rain fills rivers and streams.

3. D — A skilled farmer
   People's skills and labour are human resources.

4. A — What a good citizen is
   The introduction gives the main idea.

5. D — Every five years
   Kenya holds general elections every five years.

6. A — 47
   The Constitution of Kenya 2010 created 47 counties.

7. A — Dry areas in the far north
   Dry northern areas are sparsely populated.

8. A — Doing your class duty without being reminded
   Responsible pupils do their duties.

9. A — A person who stands to be elected
   Candidates ask for votes.

10. D — A group of elected pupils who help to run the school
   It is made up of pupils chosen by their classmates.

11. A — A title
   A good map has a title, a north arrow and a key.

12. C — National Museums of Kenya
   The National Museums of Kenya manages many museums.

13. D — The law of Kenya, including the Constitution and the Children Act
   Kenyan law protects children.

14. B — The oldest event
   Timelines run from oldest to newest.

15. B — To learn about the past and enjoy the sights
   Tourism brings income to the local people.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: Amani means peace. It is important because pupils feel safe and can learn well.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning, 1 mark for the reason.

17. (5 marks)
   Answer: A drawing with a high peak labelled mountain, a low dip labelled valley and a flat area labelled plain.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct shape drawn and 1 mark for each label, up to 5 marks.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: A good citizen in school follows the rules, respects others and does what is good for the whole school community.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for rules/respect, 1 mark for the community idea.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: To a trusted adult such as a parent or teacher, or to the child helpline 116.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct source of help.

20. (4 marks)
   Answer: The market is north of the school. The clinic is south of the school.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct direction word and 1 mark for each correct sentence.
